properties.name: Bega Veche
properties.note: There is some confusion between Bega Veche and Beregsau
properties.note_2: I have mapped according to local knowledge where "Bega Veche" is the old course of the Bega river before canalisation (starting around Timisoara) and Beregsau is the river starting from Lipova hills (Comeat, Bogda)
properties.note_3: Hydrologically, the main flow of the Bega Veche is from Beregsau, thus in literature the whole Beregsau river is often misnamed Bega Veche
